label: Bible Study
prompt: Finally, brethren, _____. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verse: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
note: Paul's last words to Corinth — four quick charges, then the God of love and peace.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In him was life; and the life was the _____ of men.
verse: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
note: John's opening echoes Genesis: in Him was life, and that life became the light of men.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee _____ for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
note: For Jonathan's sake, David gave lame Mephibosheth his land back and a permanent seat at the king's table.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a _____ between me and death.
verse: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.
note: David to Jonathan with Saul's spear still in mind: one step between me and death.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the _____ thereof is as the flower of the field:
verse: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
note: 'All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower' — Peter quotes it in 1 Peter 1:24.
